y-m-46-09.s.s1.o.a: Yana da rhombus. Idan diagonals sun kasance daidai da juna, duk bangarorin huɗu suna daidai da tsayi.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.a: Ba kowane ɗigon huɗun da ke da diagonal na perpendicular shine rhombus ba. Nemo tsayin bangarorin huɗu kai tsaye ta amfani da daidaitawa.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.o.b: Ba za mu iya sanin ko rhombus ne ba. Muna buƙatar ƙarin tsayin diagonal.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.b: Ana ba da duk haɗin gwiwar, don haka za ku iya samun tsayin gefen kai tsaye. Wannan ba yanayin ba ne inda bayanin bai isa ba kuma ba za a iya yanke shawara ba.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.o.c: Ba rhombus ba ne. Tsawon bangarorin AB da DA sun bambanta.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.c: Kun samo kuma kun kwatanta tsayin gefen kai tsaye daga masu daidaitawa. AB² = 13 da DA² = 5.

y-m-46-09.s.s1.r.d: Diagonals kasancewa daban-daban kuma a tsaye kadai ba ya nuna ko bangarorin hudu daidai suke.
y-m-46-09.s.s1.explain: AB² = 3² + 2² = 13, BC² = 3² + 6² = 45, CD² = 1² + 6² = 37, DA² = 1² + 2² = 5, don haka tsawon gefen duk sun bambanta. Ko da diagonals sun kasance a tsaye, akwai quadrilaterals waɗanda ba rhombuses ba.

y-m-46-09.s.s2.r.e: Bayanin cewa kusurwa ɗaya ba kusurwar dama ba ce kusan komai game da tsayin gefen.

Idan duka bangarorin hudu daidai ne a tsayi, rhombus ne ta ma'anarsa. Sauran sharuɗɗan duk sun gamsu da sifofi (ba rhombuses) kamar A (0, 0), B (2, 2), C (0, 8), D (-2, 2), don haka ba su da garantin ƙarshe.
y-m-46-09.s.s3.prompt: Nemo kuma shigar da daidaitawa daban-daban guda uku (p, q) na D ta yadda ABCD ta hudu tare da A(0, 0), B (5, 0), D (p, q) (q> 0), C (5 + p, q) rhombus ne.

y-m-46-05.material:

y-m-46-04.topic: Wurin maki masu rabon tazara tsayayyiya
y-m-46-04.goal: Bambance iyakar abin da hujjar wasu maki kaɗan za ta iya nunawa, nemo ƙarin maki masu cika sharadi don hasashen siffar wurin, sannan bayyana hanyar da ake buƙata don tabbatarwa.
y-m-46-04.material:
A jirgin coordinate akwai A(−2,0), B(4,0), maki P yana cika PB=2×PA. (PA tazarar P zuwa A ce.) 민호 ya ce: “Idan PA=PB, P yana kan matsakaicin rabin layi mai tsaye da AB (layi). Idan rabo 1:2 ne, waɗannan P ma za su kasance kan layi guda.” Don bincika furucin 민호, an gwada maki huɗu masu PB=2PA.
Maki | PA | PB | PB=2PA
P1(0,0) | 2 | 4 | ya cika
P2(−8,0) | 6 | 12 | ya cika
P3(−4,4) | √20 | √80 | ya cika
P4(−4,−4) | √20 | √80 | ya cika
(√20 ana karanta “tushen ashirin”.) [lambobi: 2, 0, 4, 0, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 0, 0, 2, 4, 2, 8, 0, 6, 12, 3, 4, 4, 20, 80, 4, 4, 4, 20, 80, 20]

y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.a: Samun maki da ke cika sharadi ya bambanta da kasancewarsu a layi ɗaya. Kwatanta matsayinsu huɗun.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.o.b: Sifar da maki huɗun suka zana da’ira ce, saboda haka wurin maki da’ira ne.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.b: Ko da maki huɗun suna kan da’ira ɗaya, babu tabbacin duk maki masu cika sharadin suna kan wannan da’irar.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.o.c: Maki huɗun ba sa kan layi ɗaya, saboda haka furucin Minho ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.c: Maki na ainihi masu cika sharadin ba sa kan layi ɗaya gaskiya ce ta ƙaryatawa.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.o.d: Maki huɗu ne kawai, ba za mu iya cewa komai ko furucin 민호 daidai ne ko kuskure ba.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.r.d: Yana da wuya a tabbatar daidai ne, amma za a iya nuna kuskure da misalin ƙaryatawa guda.
y-m-46-04.s.s1.explain: P1 da P2 suna kan x-axis, P3 kuma ba ya kan x-axis, saboda haka maki huɗun ba layi ɗaya ba ne. Waɗannan maki ainihin maki ne masu cika sharadi, don haka furucin “duk P suna kan layi guda” ba daidai ba ne. Amma maki huɗu kaɗai ba su isa tabbatar da “wurin maki da’ira ne” ba.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da maki P(x,y) daban-daban guda 3 masu PB=2PA waɗanda ba a tebur ba. (Za ka iya rubuta coordinates zuwa wurin goma ɗaya. Muna karɓar idan bambancin PB da 2PA bai wuce 0.25 ba saboda zagayawa.)
y-m-46-04.s.s2.hint.0: Zana maki tebur a jirgin coordinate don ganin siffa, sannan zaɓi sabbin maki bisa sifar ka gwada PB=2PA.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi x-coordinate zuwa wurin goma ɗaya, kimanta y da calculator da ke ba da PB=2PA, sannan kwatanta tazarori kai tsaye.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.ok.c1: PB daidai yake da 2PA (cikin kuskuren zagayawa).
y-m-46-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Bambancin PB da 2PA babba ne. Ƙididdige tazarori daga maki zuwa A da B kai tsaye ka kwatanta.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Wuri ne da ba ya tebur.
y-m-46-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Wuri ne da ya riga ya tebur ko ya yi kusa sosai.

y-m-46-04.s.s3.prompt: Makin da ka samo duk suna kama da suna kan da’ira ɗaya. To za mu iya ƙarasa cewa “saitin duk maki P masu PB=2PA shi ne wannan da’ira”? Rubuta ko za mu iya, da abin da ya rage don tabbatarwa.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.hint.0: Yi tunanin maki irin nawa maki da aka rubuta a jadawali za su iya wakilta.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da za ka gani idan ka sa P=(x, y), ka rubuta sharadin a matsayin ma’auni.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Hanyar gwajin da na rubuta ta rufe ɓangarorin biyu ne: “kowace maki a wannan da’ira tana cika sharadin” da “kowace maki da ta cika sharadin tana kan wannan da’ira”?
y-m-46-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa ba za a yanke hukunci da maki kaɗan ba?
y-m-46-04.s.s3.model.0: Ba a tabbatar ba tukuna. Samun wasu maki a da’ira guda ba ya tabbatar da cewa duk maki masu cika sharadin suna kan da’irar. Dole a saka P(x, y), a ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu na PB = 2PA zuwa murabba’i, a faɗaɗa a sauƙaƙa, sannan a duba ko ma’aunin da ya samu ma’aunin da’ira ne.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.model.1: Maki kaɗan ne kawai, saboda haka bai kamata a yanke ƙarshe ba. Ga dukkan maki P dole a rubuta PB² = 4PA² a matsayin ma’aunin x, y, a sauƙaƙa a ga ko ya zama (x + 4)² + y² = 16, sannan a duba baya ko kowace maki a wannan da’irar tana cika sharadin.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa misali da ta ambaci ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-46-04.s.s3.model.2: Makin jadawali wasu maki ne kawai, saboda haka ba za mu iya tabbatar da da’ira ba. Ya kamata mu tsara ma’auni mu sauƙaƙa shi, sannan mu bincika sauran maki na da’irar.

y-m-46-07.topic: Matsakaicin ƙimar wani furuci mai layi a cikin yanki
y-m-46-07.goal: Nemo kuskuren da ke cikin mafita da ta samo matsakaici ta hanyar gwada maki masu lamba cikakkiya kaɗai; kai da kanka ka samar da maki a yankin da ke ba da ƙima mafi girma, sannan ka tantance ainihin matsakaicin.
y-m-46-07.material: Yanki D: x² + y² ≤ 4 shi ne da’ira mai tsakiyar asali da radius 2, tare da cikin da’irarta. 태민 ya so ya nemo mafi girman ƙimar x + y a cikin maki (x, y) na D, don haka ya tattara kuma ya gwada maki masu x da y lamba cikakkiya kaɗai. Ga mafitar 태민 a ƙasa. (Ana karanta x² + y² ≤ 4 da “x murabba’i da y murabba’i bai wuce 4 ba”.)

y-m-46-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin da bai dace ba a mafitar 태민.
y-m-46-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunani ko maki da 태민 ya yi la’akari da su su ne dukkan maki a D.
y-m-46-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane layi, nuna ko yana magana ne game da “maki masu lamba cikakkiya” ko kuma “dukkan maki a D”.
y-m-46-07.s.s1.line.0: Maki masu x da y lamba cikakkiya a D su ne (0, 0), (±1, 0), (0, ±1), (±1, ±1), (±2, 0), (0, ±2).
y-m-46-07.s.s1.line.1: A cikinsu, maki masu mafi girman x + y su ne (2, 0), (0, 2), (1, 1), kuma ƙimar kowannensu ita ce 2.
y-m-46-07.s.s1.line.2: Maki (1, 2) da (2, 1) suna da x² + y² = 5 > 4, saboda haka suna wajen D.
y-m-46-07.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka matsakaicin x + y a D shi ne 2.
y-m-46-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne bai dace ba. Layuka na 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne idan an kalli maki masu lamba cikakkiya kawai. Amma D yana da maki waɗanda ba lambobi cikakkiya ba, kuma layi na 4 ya ɗauki sakamakon maki masu lamba cikakkiya ya shafa wa dukkan maki a D. Misali, (1.4, 1.4) yana da 1.96 + 1.96 = 3.92 ≤ 4, don haka maki ne a D, kuma x + y = 2.8 > 2.
y-m-46-07.s.s2.prompt: Ka samar da maki biyu daban-daban (x, y) a D waɗanda x + y > 2. (Za a iya amfani da adadi mai digo.)
y-m-46-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙimomin (x, y) waɗanda ba lambobi cikakkiya ba ne, sannan da farko ka lissafta x² + y² domin tabbatar da cewa bai wuce 4 ba.
y-m-46-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda x + y ke sauyawa idan x da y ƙima ɗaya ne da kuma idan sun bambanta.
y-m-46-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Makin yana wajen D. Ka duba ko x² + y² bai wuce 4 ba.
y-m-46-07.s.s2.fail.c2: x + y bai wuce 2 ba. Kana bukatar nemo maki da ya zarce matsakaicin 2 na 태민.
y-m-46-07.s.s2.explain: (1.4, 1.4) yana ba da x + y = 2.8, kuma (1.5, 1.2) yana da x² + y² = 3.69 ≤ 4 da x + y = 2.7. Dukansu sun fi 2, suna nuna cewa matsakaicin 태민 ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-46-07.s.s3.prompt: Wace ƙima ce ta dace da mafi girman ƙimar da x + y zai iya samu a D?
y-m-46-07.s.s3.hint.0: Layukan x + y = k suna da gangara −1. Ka yi tunanin matsayin layi na ƙarshe da zai taɓa D yayin da k ke ƙaruwa.
y-m-46-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka bayyana alaƙar matsayin wannan layi na ƙarshe da da’irar ta amfani da tazara daga tsakiya.
y-m-46-07.s.s3.r.a: Wannan ita ce ƙimar k da idan aka ɗauki x + y = k a matsayin layi mai taɓawa, tazararsa daga tsakiya ta yi daidai da radius. Ana samun wannan ƙimar a maki (√2, √2) na D.
y-m-46-07.s.s3.r.b: Wannan ita ce ƙimar 태민 da ya samu ta kallon maki masu lamba cikakkiya kawai. Ka riga ka tabbatar cewa maki marasa lamba cikakkiya sun ba da ƙima mafi girma.
y-m-46-07.s.s3.r.c: √6 kusan 2.45 ne. Ka kwatanta ko ƙimar x + y ta maki da ka ƙirƙira a matakin baya ta riga ta wuce shi.
y-m-46-07.s.s3.r.d: Layi x + y = 3 yana da tazarar 3/√2 ≈ 2.12 daga asali, wadda ta fi radius 2 girma; saboda haka ba ya haɗuwa da D.
y-m-46-07.s.s3.explain: Domin x + y = k ya haɗu da D, tazarar |k|/√2 daga asali dole ta zama bai wuce 2 ba; saboda haka k ≤ 2√2. Matsakaicin shi ne 2√2 ≈ 2.83, ana samunsa a maki (√2, √2). Ainihin matsakaicin yana tsakanin ƙimar 태민 2 da ƙimar 2.8 ta maki marar lamba cikakkiya (1.4, 1.4).

y-m-46-06.topic: Sharadin da ke sa layi ya zama layin taɓawa ga da’ira.
y-m-46-06.goal: Bayyana sharadin taɓa da’ira ta hanyoyi biyu, sannan ƙirƙiri layukan taɓawa da dama ga da’irar da aka bayar, ka bayyana hanyar.
y-m-46-06.material: Da’ira C: (x − 2)² + (y − 2)² = 4 tana da tsakiya (2, 2), radius 2. Tana taɓa axis x a (2, 0), axis y kuma a (0, 2). Ga p, q tabbatattu, a duba layin l: x/p + y/q = 1 mai x-intercept p da y-intercept q (wanda ake sauƙaƙawa zuwa qx + py − pq = 0). Ka duba dangantakar alwatikan da layin nan da axis biyu suka kewaye da C. ((x − 2)² ana karantawa x a rage 2 murabba’i.)
y-m-46-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da kanka da suka cika sharadin.
y-m-46-06.prereq.2: Nisa daga maki zuwa layi, ko discriminant na ma’aunin digiri biyu.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da suka dace don tabbatar layin l yana taɓa da’ira C.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka hango hanyoyin da layi zai iya haɗuwa da da’ira ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka ƙirga wuraren haɗuwa.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin abin da ke faruwa tsakanin tsakiya da layi idan wurin haɗuwa guda ɗaya ne kawai.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.o.a: Discriminant na ma’aunin da aka samu ta haɗa l da C ya zama 0.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.r.a: Idan ma’aunin haɗin yana da tushen ninki biyu, wurin haɗuwa guda ɗaya ne, don haka layin taɓawa ne. Wannan hanya tana ba da ƙarshe iri ɗaya da hanyar nisa.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.o.b: Ma’aunin haɗa l da C yana da tushen ainihi.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.r.b: Samun tushen ainihi yana nufin aƙalla wurin haɗuwa ɗaya ne. Ya haɗa da wuraren haɗuwa biyu, don haka ba sharadin layin taɓawa kaɗai ba ne.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.o.c: L yana wucewa ta tsakiyar da’irar (2, 2).
y-m-46-06.s.s1.r.c: Layi da ya ratsa tsakiyar da’ira yana haɗuwa da da’irar a maki biyu. Layi mai taɓawa ba ya ratsa tsakiyar.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.o.d: Tazarar daga tsakiyar (2, 2) zuwa L daidai take da radius 2.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ita ce hanyar kwatanta tazarar daga tsakiya zuwa layi da radius.
y-m-46-06.s.s1.explain: Kasancewa mai taɓawa yana nufin akwai maki ɗaya tak da suke haɗuwa; saboda haka ko dai discriminant na haɗaɗɗiyar ma’auni ya zama 0, ko kuma tazarar daga tsakiya zuwa layi ta yi daidai da radius. Hanyoyin biyu suna ba da sakamako iri ɗaya. Samun tushen gaske kaɗai ma na iya nufin akwai maki biyu na haɗuwa.
y-m-46-06.s.s2.prompt: Yi ƙirƙirar nau’i-nau’i biyu daban-daban (p, q) ta yadda layi L mai yanke axis x a p da axis y a q zai taɓa da’ira C. (p da q lambobi masu kyau ne.)
y-m-46-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ka daidaita p ɗaya, sannan ka sauya q kana gwadawa don gano ƙimar da tazarar daga tsakiya zuwa layi ta zama 2.
y-m-46-06.s.s2.hint.1: Wata hanya ita ce ka fara tunanin wani (p, q) da bangarorin uku na alwatikarsa lambobi cikakku ne.
y-m-46-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole p da q su zama masu kyau.
y-m-46-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Tazarar daga tsakiya zuwa L ita ce 2.
y-m-46-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Tazarar daga tsakiyar (2, 2) zuwa layi qx + py − pq = 0 ba 2 ba ce. Ba layi mai taɓawa ba ne.
y-m-46-06.s.s2.explain: Idan (p, q) = (6, 8), layin shi ne 8x + 6y − 48 = 0, kuma tazarar zuwa tsakiya ita ce |16 + 12 − 48| ÷ 10 = 2. Ga (5, 12), kuwa, ita ce |24 + 10 − 60| ÷ 13 = 2. Musayar p da q, kamar (12, 5) da (8, 6), tana ba da misalai iri ɗaya.
y-m-46-06.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta hanya ɗaya da za a bi don tabbatar da cewa layin yana taɓa da’ira C idan (p, q) = (6, 8), sannan kuma a rubuta jimla ɗaya ko biyu game da yadda aka samo sabon (p, q).
y-m-46-06.s.s3.hint.0: Sake rubuta ma’aunin layin a sigar qx + py − pq = 0.
y-m-46-06.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta ƙimar da tazarar daga tsakiya zuwa layi dole ta zama idan layin yana taɓawa.

y-m-46-06.s.s3.model.0: Tazarar daga tsakiyar (2, 2) zuwa layi 8x + 6y − 48 = 0 ita ce |16 + 12 − 48| ÷ √(64 + 36) = 20 ÷ 10 = 2, wanda ya yi daidai da radius; saboda haka layin yana taɓawa. Ga sabon nau’in, na daidaita p a 5, na nemi q da zai sa ya taɓa, kuma na samu q = 12.

Radius ɗin 2 ne, don haka na gwada alwatikar 5-12-13 haka nan.

y-m-46-10.title: Motsa iri biyu: shin sakamakon iri ɗaya ne idan kun musanya oda?
y-m-46-10.goal: Gwada tare da lokuta da yawa yadda tsari ya shafi sakamakon lokacin da aka yi fassarar da tunani a cikin layi y = x daya bayan daya, nemo yanayin da sakamakon ya kasance iri ɗaya ko da an canza tsari, kuma bayyana dalilin.
y-m-46-10.material: Da'irar C: (x - 1)² + (y - 2)² = 4 yana da tsakiya (1, 2) da radius 2. Yi la'akari da motsi biyu. T(a, b): Fassara kowane batu ta hanyar a cikin x da b a cikin y. S: yi tunani a cikin layi y = x. (A batu (p, q) ana matsawa zuwa (q, p)) "T sai S" yana nufin yin T farko sannan S akan sakamakon, kuma "S to T" yana nufin yin S farko sannan T akan sakamakon. Da'irar tana kiyaye radius lokacin motsi, don haka kawai kuna buƙatar bin matsayin cibiyar. ((x - 1) ² ana karanta "x debe 1, murabba'i," kuma y = x ana karanta "y daidai x.")
y-m-46-10.thinking.1: Bita hukunci tare da misalan misalan
y-m-46-10.prereq.2: Tunani a fadin x-axis (x, y) → (x, -y) da ma'aunin da'irar
y-m-46-10.s.s1.prompt: Duk lokacin da aka bayyana shari'a, zaɓi hukunci game da ko sakamakon umarni biyu ('T sannan S', 'S sannan T') ɗaya ne.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.hint.0: Bi cibiya ɗaya kawai (1, 2) kuma rubuta haɗin kai a kowane mataki.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.hint.1: A cikin tebur, rukunin rukunin da suke iri ɗaya da layuka waɗanda suka bambanta, kuma nemi abin da suke da alaƙa.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Mun gwada T(3, 3). "T sai S": tsakiya (1, 2) → (4, 5) → (5, 4). "S sai T": tsakiya (1, 2) → (2, 1) → (5, 4). Sakamakon umarni biyu iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ganin wannan harka, menene ra'ayinku a yanzu game da ko sakamakon umarni biyu iri daya ne?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Don T(3, 3), sakamakon umarni biyu iri ɗaya ne. Amma akwai shari'ar guda ɗaya kawai, don haka ba za mu iya sanin ko wannan ma gaskiya ne ga sauran T.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Idan an canza tsari, sakamakon koyaushe yana bambanta.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: A cikin lamarin da kuka gani yanzu, sun kasance iri ɗaya. Wannan da'awar bai dace da lamarin ba.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Duk wani motsi T shine, sakamakon umarni biyu koyaushe iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akwai shari'a ɗaya kawai. Ba za ku iya ƙarasa "ko da yaushe" daga shari'a ɗaya ba. Kuna buƙatar gwada wasu T kuma.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Da'irar ce, don haka daidai yake ba tare da la'akari da tsari ba.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ya kamata ku bi inda cibiyar ke tafiya, ba siffar da'irar ba.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Haka suke a wannan yanayin. Muna buƙatar ƙarin gwaji don sanin ko sun kasance iri ɗaya ga sauran T kuma.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan wani hali ne na yin la'akari da ko za a iya ƙara wani abu da ya kasance ɗaya a cikin wani lamari zuwa ga shari'ar gaba ɗaya.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Mun gwada T(3, 0). "T sai S": tsakiya (1, 2) → (4, 2) → (2, 4). "S sai T": tsakiya (1, 2) → (2, 1) → (5, 1). Sakamakon biyu ya bambanta.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ganin wannan harka, me za ku yi da tunanin ku na farko?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Cibiyar "T sai S" ita ce (2, 4) kuma cibiyar "S sai T" ita ce (5, 1), don haka suna da'ira daban-daban. Wani misali ya bayyana, don haka kalmar "koyaushe suna ɗaya" ba ta riƙe.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wannan shari'ar ta musamman ce, don haka na kiyaye tunanina na farko kamar yadda yake.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tunanin 'koyaushe iri ɗaya' ya karye ta hanyar misali ɗaya. Duba lissafin wannan shari'ar kuma.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Sauke tunanin 'koyaushe iri ɗaya' kuma ga cewa ya bambanta dangane da T.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kun bar 'koyaushe' saboda misali ɗaya kuma kun tsara cewa ya bambanta dangane da yanayin.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Dole ne lissafin ya zama kuskure. Ya kamata ya ba da sakamako iri ɗaya.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Cibiyoyin biyu suna fitowa daban-daban, (2, 4) da (5, 1). Maimaita lissafin biyu da kanka.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Girman da'irar yana canzawa maimakon matsayi na tsakiya, don haka ba za a iya kwatanta su ba.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Fassara da tunani ba sa canza radius na da'irar.

y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Menene yanayin dacewa akan (a,b) don sakamakon umarni biyu su zama iri ɗaya?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.after: A cikin "T sai S" cibiyar ita ce (2 + b, 1 + a), kuma a cikin "S to T" ita ce (2 + a, 1 + b), don haka suna ɗaya kawai lokacin 2 + b = 2 + a, wato, lokacin a = b. Tun da S yana musanya x-coordinate da y-coordinate, idan T aka fara yi, fassarar adadin a da b kuma ana musanya su.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Sai kawai lokacin da a = 0 (b zai iya zama kowace ƙima)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: A cikin (3, 3) da (-2, -2), a ba 0 ba ne amma sakamakon iri ɗaya ne. Dubi menene ƙimar layuka ɗaya a cikin tebur ɗin ke da alaƙa.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Sai kawai lokacin a = -b (lokacin da a da b suna da alamun sabani)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: A cikin layuka guda na tebur, alamun a da b iri ɗaya ne. Nemo abin da layuka iri ɗaya ke da alaƙa.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Sai kawai lokacin a = b (lokacin da nisan motsi biyu daidai suke)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Layukan da suka kasance iri ɗaya suna da a = b, kuma waɗanda suka bambanta suna da ≠ b. Idan kun bi tsarin haɗin gwiwar cibiyar, yana da sharadi don 2 + b da 2 + a zama daidai, kuma don 1 + a da 1 + b su zama daidai.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Sun kasance iri ɗaya a cikin (3, 3) da (-2, -2).
y-m-46-10.s.s1.reflect: A cikin shari'ar farko (3, 3), amsar "daya ce," sannan a cikin na biyu "mabambanta" ya fito. Dubi abin da ke da haɗari game da gabaɗaya daga shari'ar guda ɗaya inda suka kasance iri ɗaya, da kuma menene layuka iri ɗaya da layuka daban-daban na teburin suke da alaƙa.

y-m-46-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane oda, rubuta x-coordinate da y-coordinate na cibiyar, layi ɗaya kowanne.

y-m-46-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shin kun rubuta banbance ko ayyukan fassarar sun kai a da b an musanya su ko kuma ba a musanya su ba yayin wucewa ta cikin tunani?
y-m-46-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin kun kuma yi tunanin dalilin da yasa babu bambanci lokacin a = b?
y-m-46-10.s.s2.model.0: Idan T aka fara yi, cibiyar ta zama (1 + a, 2 + b), kuma tunda S ya canza x-coordinate da y-coordinate, ya zama (2 + b, 1 + a). Idan S aka fara yi, yana motsawa a kwance ta a kuma a tsaye ta b. Don haka idan a da b sun bambanta, sakamakon ya dogara da tsari.
